notes.title: Hello community
notes.content:
It has been a while since last announcement and now is a perfect time to bring up some news and information.

As some of you that follow and support us have noticed a variety of screenshots here and there we're moving away from the WW2 theme completely. We're going for stylized cartoony graphics and much more unrealistically unrealistic weapons and vehicles.https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33630773/dca6a0d03629ef8df35b45390075f58ff26a41ad.png

What does this all mean?
-New art style
-New weapons (Some old ones too, sort of, kind of...)
-New fun features you will see a bit later ;)
-Much wider options for game development
-More community suggestion implementations possible in the near future, just use imagination and suggest what ever you think would be cool in a third person shooter game.
-Flying tanks just became a possibility ːsteamhappyː

"But I wanna play it now! see how it look, feel and tastes!"
-There will be an announcement when we will start handing out keys for the game (Those that had a key for the WW2 themed game will need a new one, sorry)
-We have lots of guns, gadgets etc. to remodel, so please be patient.
-We need more testers. It's lonely for the devs to play  alone :(

But I wanna play!
-We will get to that point when we (Devs) feel like the game is in good shape and we have enough testers to fill up the test session. 

"Can I help the project?"
-Everyone can help us by sharing our content and telling friends about this project 
-Give us feedback (preferably telling us how super cool the project looks, so we stay motivated) ːsteammockingː
-Discuss, suggest, react and comment.
-Know gaming community? Let Igor know about them so we might get them into testing

Join us on Discord to influence the development, chat and join future tests.
https://discord.gg/ERnsDzJ

See you all on our #General channel!

notes.title: LOOKING FOR TESTERS & GAME COMMUNITIES
notes.content:
Hello keyboard warriors,

We're looking for dedicated testers and gaming communities to participate in our open alpha---> beta tests.


TESTERS

Join our discord https://discord.gg/ATC7D6C and type !tester in general chat to get the role and see all scheduled test and times.

Why?

We need to stress test the gameplay and break the game (or try).

Register on our bugtracker, report bugs and receive exclusive rewards on release that no one else will get!

Also you can record/stream gameplay, can even get extra keys to share with your viewers!

Influence the development with your own ideas and feature suggestions.

GAMING COMMUNITIES

Get your own dedicated server build of the game and play BULLETGROUNDS on your own schedule. 

Provide us with feedback about gameplay and share ideas.


TEST TIMES AND SCHEDULES

We're EU based, so official open alpha tests are held on:
Saturdays/Sundays around 6pm CET.


Don't delay, join our discord today! https://discord.gg/ATC7D6C
And bring your friends.

notes.title: End of November update logs
notes.content:
Hello community
Another month gone by with a few test sessions on the front lines.
Tomorrow it's time to shave off your Movembers and prepare for some serious combat action, so look sharp and drive fear into your enemies hearts!


Below is the changelog for next test session:
Plane
-Steering completely controlled with mouse and camera angle changes on sharp turns, giving you a better perspective what is going around your plane.
Suggested by community member: kraken_07_ AKA POUTINE

Tanks
-Camera stabilizer (crosshair wont be bouncing on every bump)
-Hitbox added for turret collision (was missing)

Infantry
-Life regeneration kicks in after 15 seconds of not taking any damage and heals player for 10hp/second. 
-Helmets will block % of damage instead of negate full damage on hit.
-Added sound to helmet impacts
-Added camera shoulder switching (default key: Caps lock)
-Added minor camera shake to walking
-Adjusted camera height for better usage in buildings and bunkers
-Adjusted camera distance, now closer to character
-Characters have close quarters animation to aiming if your target is next to you

Weapons & kits
-Sniper head shots now kill instantly
-removed "autofire" mechanic from semiautos (previously could hold down mouse1 to autofire)
-Ammobox, medkit and mines are now dropped instantly on equip
-Added proper pistol for germans
-Fixed bazooka hitting player on shoot
-Flamethrower tweaked

Buildables
-New sandbag model providing better cover
-Barbed wire fence, spawn 5 at a time
-Tank traps spawnd in clusters of 3
-Bunkers disabled for redesign

Game mode
-Pushit has a victory condition
-Map restart when game ends
-Scoreboards have proper player names (used to have pc names)
-Building walls take damage from other than explosive sources
-Score are now grouped by type, rather than all scores being independent (damage numbers shouldn't flood your screen)
-Added new score types

notes.title: News from the front
notes.content:
What's up BULLETGROUNDS community!

First of all we want to thank everyone who participated on 24:th of November test session, we got lots of feedback & suggestions!

Why feedback and suggestions are important?
Well here is a good example:
Our community member kraken_07_ AKA POUTINE gave feedback and followed up by a suggestion on how to improve flying experience and make it fun.
We implemented, tested and everyone will see the feature in 1:st of December test session!
HUGE thanks to kraken_07_ AKA POUTINE!

Work work and more work
This week we have been doing a lot of improvements and by a lot i mean A LOT.
